headline: New operational plan 'more devastating than the 12-day and 40-day wars', will follow 'unfamiliar rules'
dek: Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Major General Mohsen Rezaei said Iran's Armed Forces have prepared a plan for any new US-Israeli 'adventurism' that would be more devastating than the 12-day and 40-day wars, and that the new operational plan 'will not proceed according to the…
sources: Mohsen Rezaei's X post (Sunday); reported by IRNA (state wire), Tasnim, PressTV
fault_line: Is Tehran bluffing — or does Iran really have a retaliation plan Washington cannot predict?

sections.what_happened: Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Major General Mohsen Rezaei said Iran's Armed Forces have prepared a plan for any new US-Israeli 'adventurism' that would be more devastating than the 12-day and 40-day wars, and that the new operational plan 'will not proceed according to the rules they are familiar with.' Response to recent US/Israeli threats including reported consideration of MOAB (GBU-43/B) strikes on Iran (CNN, Oct 15 — attributed report). Brig. Gen. Alireza Sheikh added the army is fully prepared, dismissing MOAB talk as intimidation.
sections.what_verified: IRNA, Tasnim, PressTV, JPost live blog, ua.news, sundayguardian all report the same X post and quotes.
sections.what_disputed: No independently verifiable evidence of the new plan's existence, capabilities, or targets — a deterrent threat, not a fact about capability. CNN's MOAB-strike-plans report is itself an attributed report, not confirmed US policy.
sections.why_matters: Iran's top security chief answers US 'Mother of All Bombs' talk with a promise of an 'unfamiliar' war — deterrence math from Tehran's side, with the MOAB report labeled as US-media sourcing. Connects to Hormuz leverage: the threat package is military + energy-chokepoint.
sections.context: Background: Iran SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei: new operational plan 'more devastating than the 12-day and 40-day wars', will follow 'unfamiliar rules'

totw_analysis: Our read: Iran's top security chief answers US 'Mother of All Bombs' talk with a promise of an 'unfamiliar' war — deterrence math from Tehran's side, with the MOAB report labeled as US-media sourcing. Connects to Hormuz leverage: the threat package is military + energy-chokepoint. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is Tehran bluffing — or does Iran really have a retaliation plan Washington cannot predict?
